title: Affine-flat sections give flat stalks
statement: For a scheme Y, module sheaf G, affine-local flatness IsFlatOver G (𝟙 Y), and point x : Y, the stalk G_x is flat over the stalk ring O_{Y,x}.

source.place: Lemma flat-stalks-flat, using Algebra Lemma colimit-flat and localization flatness

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood V of x. Affine neighbourhoods U contained in V form a filtered basis, and the stalk is their filtered colimit as an O(V)-module. The hypothesis makes each G(U) flat over O(V), so the filtered colimit is flat. The stalk ring is the localization of O(V) at x, and localization flatness equivalence transfers flatness to O_{Y,x}.
